target: Gato escaldado tem medo de água fria.
english: A scalded cat fears cold water.
tip: Gato escaldado, a scalded cat, carries the once bitten, twice shy idea: one bad burn leaves you wary of even harmless cold water.

target: Ela deixou de responder minhas mensagens.
tip: Deixar de plus an infinitive means to stop doing something. Ela deixou de responder = she stopped answering.

target: Sem embargo de toda a polêmica, o projeto foi adiante.
english: Notwithstanding all the controversy, the project went ahead.
tip: Embargo here isn't a trade ban. Sem embargo de is a formal legal connective meaning notwithstanding or in spite of.

target: Em sendo assim, não há mais o que discutir.
english: That being the case, there's nothing more to discuss.
tip: Em plus a gerund, as in em sendo assim, is literally in being so, a formal Portuguese pattern English never builds.

target: Não fossem as circunstâncias, teria agido de outra forma.
english: Were it not for the circumstances, I would have acted differently.
tip: Não fossem plus a noun means were it not for. Não fossem as circunstâncias = if it weren't for the circumstances.

target: O sertão vai virar mar, e o mar vai virar sertão.
english: The backlands will become sea, and the sea will become backlands.
tip: In Antônio Conselheiro's sertão-and-mar prophecy, virar is the everyday become-verb: virar mar means to turn into sea.

target: Oxalá as gerações futuras colham os frutos do que plantamos hoje.
english: May future generations reap the fruits of what we plant today.
tip: Oxalá means hopefully or may it be, and it always triggers the subjunctive. That is why the verb is colham, not colhem.

target: O baião de Gonzagão é patrimônio cultural brasileiro.
english: Gonzagão's baião is Brazilian cultural heritage.
tip: Gonzagão adds the -ão augmentative to Gonzaga, the baião king, giving big Gonzaga, an affectionate size-up Portuguese applies to people.

target: Vossa Excelência está convidada para a cerimônia.
english: Your Excellency is invited to the ceremony.
tip: Vossa Excelência takes a third-person verb, so it goes with está, not estás, even though you address one person.

target: Não há de ser fácil convencê-los do contrário.
english: It won't be easy to convince them otherwise.
tip: The pattern haver de plus an infinitive expresses expectation about the future. Não há de ser fácil = it won't be easy.

target: Quando eu o vir, darei o recado.
english: When I see him, I'll give him the message.
tip: Here vir is the future subjunctive of ver (to see), not the verb vir (to come). Quando eu o vir = when I see him.

target: Far-se-á necessária uma revisão completa do sistema.
english: A complete review of the system will be necessary.
tip: In far-se-á the pronoun se sits inside the future verb, splitting fará open. This ultra-formal split is written and legal only, never spoken.

target: Sem prejuízo das demais disposições, aplicam-se as seguintes normas.
english: Without prejudice to other provisions, the following rules apply.
tip: Prejuízo usually means loss or harm, not prejudice, which is preconceito. Yet sem prejuízo de is the legal calque of without prejudice to.
